name: Toyota Motor Corporation
blurb: Toyota Motor Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells passenger vehicles, minivans, commercial vehicles, and related parts globally. It operates through Automotive, Financial Services, and All Other segments, offering a wide range of vehicles from subcompact cars to trucks and buses. As one of the world's largest automakers, Toyota holds a significant market position with a market cap of approximately ¥39.1 trillion and revenue of ¥50.45 trillion (ttm).
recent: Over the past month, Toyota's stock has traded in a range of ¥2,434–¥4,000, recently closing at ¥2,978. The company reported net income of ¥3.70 trillion (down 27.5% year-over-year) and an EPS of ¥283.38 (down 25.8%). Notable news includes discussions on Japanese carmakers deepening their hold in emerging markets and the impact of AI on high-paying IT jobs.
